pretreatments.description: Mechanical grinding using an in-sink food disposer (Badger 9 model) with a strainer hole size of 0.75 cm.
Mechanical grinding using a manual meat grinder (Grizzly H7778 No 32) with a medium extrusion plate opening of 1.0 cm.
Mechanical grinding using a manual meat grinder (Grizzly H7778 No 32) with a small extrusion plate opening of 0.5 cm.

Enzymatic hydrolysis using a commercial digestive enzyme formulation (Digest®) containing cellulases, amylases, proteases and lipases from Aspergillus niger and Aspergillus oryzae applied at a dosage rate of 1 g per 10 g of food waste.
Dilution with a buffered aqueous solution (phosphate buffer: 0.5 M NaOH titrated into 0.5 M KH2PO4 to pH 6.5) to 3.5 g COD L−1.
